text:
sophie: heads-up — i'm opening a tiny docs PR to add a short compatibility checklist and two usage examples for the new slim variant. thinking we keep it minimal: supported limits, recommended quant, and one embed/prompt snippet.

ashley: SGTM. can you add a short note about seq_length=4096 fallback? we've seen a few surprises on the dedicated runtime. :eyes:

sophie: yes — i'll add a sentence under 'limits' + a one-liner about fallback behavior. also planning to include a small SDK snippet for python and a curl example.

mira: ping on the embed example — for shard-aware apps we should show the quick guide to shard ids. maybe this small snippet: 

```python
# embed sharding example (pseudo)
def shard_embed(embed_id, num_shards):
    return hash(embed_id) % num_shards

# usage: results = client.embeddings.create(model="slim-3b", input=[...], shard_id=shard_embed(key, 8))
```

mira: put that under "embeddings -> sharding" and add a faq link to the embed-sharding doc.

chris: quick note: the runtime currently maps slim-3b -> slim-3b-quant by policy for low-memory nodes. we should call that out so users understand variations in perf/quality.

sophie: good catch. i'll add a short compatibility note: "slim-3b may route to quantized variant on constrained nodes; expect ~1.2x slower generation and slightly fuzzier logits". simple language.

paul: can you also include the bench numbers? even rough: tokens/sec on p4d and g5. just small table or inline bullets. docs-bot: generate bench link if available. :hammer:

docs-bot: link to latest bench CSV: https://bench.redwood.internal/slim-3b/latest.csv

sophie: thanks — i'll reference the CSV and paste the key numbers inline: p4d: 420 tok/s @512 seq, g5: 680 tok/s @512 seq (quantized fallback numbers in parentheses).

ashley: tiny nit — under "sdk snippet" use `client.generate(..., max_tokens=256)` instead of `length` (we standardized param names in SDK v3).

sophie: yes will update to `max_tokens`. also add a one-line migration note: "if you upgrade from sdk v2 -> v3, search/replace `length` -> `max_tokens` in examples".

mira: for links: we should fix the anchor to the sharding doc (recent rename broke anchor). i'll put the correct anchor in a comment here: /docs/embeddings#shard-routing (use lowercase, hyphen).

chris: can someone run a quick spellcheck and linter after the PR? i can do a pass after you push.

sophie: pushing the branch now: refs/heads/docs/slim-compat-1749999999. will add checklist in PR body: 1) limits section added, 2) embed shard snippet, 3) sdk snippet updated, 4) bench numbers + link, 5) compatibility note.

paul: timeline?

sophie: aiming to merge by EOD tomorrow if no blockers. requests reviewers: @ashley @chris @mira.

ashley: LGTM for review once pushed. i'll check the fallback wording.

mira: I'll verify the shard snippet and the anchor link.

chris: will run linter and bench sanity tomorrow morning.

sophie: thanks all. if anyone finds anything major before i open the PR i'll update, otherwise PR shortly. :rocket:
